record.question:
The Aspirational Districts Programme of NITI Aayog is primarily based on which of the following
    approaches?
options: Providing uniform financial assistance to all backward districts
Convergence of government schemes, collaboration among stakeholders and competition among districts based on measurable development outcomes
Transferring the implementation of all Central schemes to district administrations
Replacing State-level development planning with district-level planning
